title: Trump says US may launch ‘another little Epic Fury’ attack on Iran
paragraphs: Trump says US may launch ‘another little Epic Fury’ attack on Iran

US President Donald Trump on Friday said his country may launch “another little Epic Fury” on Iran, referring to the joint Israeli-American military operation that sparked the war with Iran at the end of February.

US President Donald Trump said on Friday Washington may carry out another military operation against Iran at a time when the war is nearing its eight-month mark and as rise in fuel prices weigh on the US midterm elections.
